description: Replicate/sync the LAPS password via directory replication rather than a direct object read.

telemetry.detail: DS Access via the replication path - requires auditing (default OFF).
Replication-style LAPS retrieval resembles small-scale DCSync behaviour to ITDR.

prerequisite_privilege: Replication rights scoped to the LAPS attribute
abuse_primitive: Sync the LAPS attribute via DRS, recover the local admin password.
notes: Between a direct ReadLAPSPassword and DCSync in character; louder than a plain read because it uses the replication channel.
